items.title: Employee Attrition Prediction
items.description: Predicted employee turnover with 85% ROC-AUC using logistic regression and decision trees in R, cross-validated across multiple data folds. Identified promotion timing, overtime, and compensation as the leading attrition drivers, translating results into an actionable HR retention strategy.

items.title: Vendor Performance Analysis
items.description: Analyzed over 15 million purchase and sales records using SQL and Python to build a comprehensive vendor performance scorecard. Uncovered a 72% unit cost reduction from bulk purchasing and statistically validated vendor profit margin gaps through hypothesis testing.

items.title: Monthly Expense Tracker
items.description: Automated personal finance tracking in Excel using dynamic formulas, lookups, conditional formatting, and sparkline visualizations. Replaced manual spreadsheet upkeep with a self-updating dashboard that instantly surfaces savings rate, category spending, and monthly financial trends.

items.title: Ecommerce Sales Dashboard
items.description: Built a full SQL Server to Power BI pipeline cleaning and modeling over 100K orders, uncovering $26.9M in tracked sales, a 0.53% cancellation rate, and a 78% positive customer review rate.
